advisories.title: The explicit deferred-or-rides summary is narrower than the accepted integration dependency ledger
advisories.detail: The join explicitly carries the DR-117/DR-010 namespace-depth and transfer/dispute deferrals and the DR-114 migration-doctor ride. Accepted integration v4 also carries the third-party support/vulnerability side on DR-116 and multi-version compatibility-matrix ownership on DR-111; both tokens are absent from this join. This is not a takeover: the candidate binds NOTHING, expressly does not retarget D-012 or D-131, and makes no claim to support or compatibility authority, so both source routes remain operative.
advisories.suggestion: A future successor could make the non-exhaustive summary easier to audit by adding explicit deferred-or-rides entries for DR-116 and DR-111, or by stating that integration v4's full identityDependencies ledger remains incorporated by reference.

summary: ACCEPT at 0 blockers and 0 SHOULD-FIX, with one non-blocking route-ledger advisory. The candidate faithfully measures DR-104 as DECIDED-V1-NOT-INTEGRATED, not OPEN: D-012 policy and the eleven-class authored corpus are not leftover, while the still-unassigned condition-4 execution route remains design leftover under the adopted D-153/D-154 gate-naming pattern. No live gate claim owns the identity/namespace negative-test property, so the candidate correctly refuses to force G15 or another near-match and assigns no new DR-G number. All 11 primary and 6 additional fixture paths exist and reproduce their pinned SHA-256 values without execution; the D-130 and D-131 candidates remain unapplied. D-012's DR-117 deferrals and the DR-114 doctor ride are preserved, required-now remains 26, no SATISFIED or Class A/Class B act occurs, and no file-08, implementation, D9, or section 7.1 authority is exercised.
